title: A machine learning-based tool for predicting transcription factor-target gene interactions in soybean.
authors: Zhu, Xueai; Zhang, Baoyi; Yang, Long; Huang, Junxian; Huang, Fang; Zhang, Hongsheng; Song, Qingxin; Huang, Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于机器学习的工具预测大豆中转录因子-靶基因互作，虽聚焦TF-DNA结合预测但缺乏三维互作建模与机制研究，方法可迁移至本课题。
